'''Spaceport Express''' was a small messenger service in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was run by the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Omon Gantum]] who gladly accepted the offer from [[Gep's Grill]] to handle orders and deliveries.

At first, Spaceport Express only handled legal goods such as food and medicines. After the business deal with [[Norun Gep]] and [[Fillin Ta]], the service became known for smuggling contraband such as stolen equipment or meat stuffed with contraband.<ref name="GG7" />
